TITLE 3 THEME 2 CHILD EDITION 


00:26 am 26-10-31 Sat


GOD IN DISGUISE


Finding the Secret Visitor in the Old Testament


Christine A.
Illustrated by [Illustrator Name]


Copyright © 2026 Christine A.. All rights reserved. This printable is for personal family use only. Not for resale. No part of this book may be reproduced in any form without permission from the author.



A Note for Parents


Have you ever played a game of hide and seek? The person hides. You look for them. You peek behind the couch. You check under the bed. You open the closet. And then you find them. And everyone laughs.


The Old Testament is a little like that. God is hiding in the stories. He is in a bush. He is in a fire. He is in a whisper. He is in a ladder. He is in a star. He is in a baby. He is in disguise.


This book is a 30 day adventure for you and your kids. Each day is a game of hide and seek. You will find God in disguise. You will find the Secret Visitor. And you will find that He was pointing to Jesus all along.


You do not need to be a Bible expert. You just need to be a good detective. Get ready to look. Get ready to find. Get ready to see God in disguise.



How to Use This Book


This is a 30 day journey. Each day takes about 5 to 10 minutes. Read the secret clue. Read the big reveal. Do the family activity together. Say the prayer out loud. Let your child color the picture or do the coloring prompt. The goal is not perfection. The goal is connection. Have fun with it. Get messy. Ask questions. Laugh together. This is a game of hide and seek. Let us begin.


---

pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"There the angel of the LORD appeared to him in flames of fire from within a bush. Moses saw that though the bush was on fire it did not burn up." - Exodus 3:2


Moses saw a bush on fire. The fire was bright. The fire was hot. But the bush did not burn up. It stayed green. It stayed whole. And a voice came from the bush. It was God. God was hiding in a bush. That is a disguise. God in a bush.


The Big Reveal


"The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son." - John 1:14


The bush was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. God hid in a bush. Then God hid in a baby. Then God hid in a man. Jesus is God in disguise. He is the Secret Visitor.


Family Activity


Go outside and find a bush. Look at it closely. Talk about how God was in the burning bush. Talk about how God is everywhere. He is not hiding from us. He wants us to find Him. Say a prayer together at the bush.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, God, for hiding in the bush. Thank you for letting Moses find you. Help me to find you too. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A green bush with bright flames and a little face peeking out.

pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"So Jacob was left alone, and a man wrestled with him till daybreak. Then the man said, 'Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God.'" - Genesis 32:24, 28


Jacob was alone. And a man came. And they wrestled. All night. The man was God. God was in a wrestling match. God was hiding in a wrestler. Jacob held on. And Jacob got a blessing.


The Big Reveal


"Jesus let himself be grabbed, beaten, and held on a cross. He did not break free. He let himself be held. For us." - Hebrews 2:9


The wrestler was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus lets us hold on to Him. He lets us grab Him. He lets us wrestle with our questions. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Have a gentle wrestling match. Let your child hold on to your arm. Say, "I will not let go." Talk about how Jacob held on to God. Talk about how we can hold on to God too. Be gentle. Be safe. Have fun.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, God, for letting me hold on to you. Thank you for being strong. Thank you for blessing me. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A person holding on tight with a big smile and a heart.

pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"He had a dream in which he saw a stairway resting on the earth, with its top reaching to heaven, and the angels of God were ascending and descending on it." - Genesis 28:12


Jacob was running away. He was scared. He fell asleep. He dreamed. He saw a ladder. It reached from earth to heaven. Angels were going up and down. God was at the top. God was hiding in a ladder. That is a disguise.


The Big Reveal


"He then added, 'Very truly I tell you, you will see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.'" - John 1:51


The ladder was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is the ladder. He connects heaven and earth. He connects us to God. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Build a ladder with blocks. Or draw one on paper. Put a star at the top for God. Talk about how the ladder goes up to heaven. Talk about how Jesus is our ladder. He connects us to God. He is the Secret Visitor.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, Jesus, for being the ladder. Thank you for connecting me to God. Thank you for being the Secret Visitor. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A big ladder reaching to the sky with angels and a star at the top.
pages.title: Day 3: God in a Ladder

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"Then the LORD opened the donkey's mouth, and it said to Balaam, 'What have I done to you to make you beat me these three times?'" - Numbers 22:28


A donkey talked. That is a disguise. God used a donkey to speak. The donkey saw an angel. The donkey stopped. The donkey saved a man's life. God was hiding in a donkey. God can use anything.


The Big Reveal


"But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong." - 1 Corinthians 1:27


The donkey was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. God uses small things. God uses weak things. God used a donkey. God used a baby. Jesus is the Secret Visitor. He comes in unexpected ways.


Family Activity


Play a game of "animal sounds." Take turns making sounds. Guess the animal. Talk about how God used a donkey to speak. Talk about how God can use anyone. He can use you. You can be a Secret Visitor too.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, God, for using small things. Thank you for using me. Thank you for the Secret Visitor. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A smiling donkey with a speech bubble and a little angel nearby.
pages.title: Day 4: God in a Donkey

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and all that night the LORD drove the sea back with a strong east wind and turned it into dry land. The waters were divided." - Exodus 14:21


The sea split in half. The water stood up like walls. The people walked through on dry ground. God was in the sea. God made a way. That is a disguise. God in the water. God in the sea.


The Big Reveal


"Jesus answered, 'I am the way and the truth and the life.'" - John 14:6


The sea was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is the way. He makes a way where there is no way. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Fill a big bowl with water. Put toy people on one side. Use a spoon to gently push the water apart. Let the toy people walk through on a dry path. Talk about how God split the sea. Talk about how Jesus makes a way for us.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, Jesus, for making a way. Thank you for being the way. Thank you for being the Secret Visitor. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A big sea with walls of water and people walking through on dry land.
pages.title: Day 5: God in a Sea

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"Look! I see four men walking around in the fire, unbound and unharmed, and the fourth looks like a son of the gods." - Daniel 3:25


Three men were thrown into a fire. But there were four men in the fire. The fourth was God. God was in the fire. Walking with His people. Keeping them safe. That is a disguise. God in a fire.


The Big Reveal


"Surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age." - Matthew 28:20


The fourth man in the fire was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is with us in the fire. He walks with us in the hard times. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Make a pretend fire with red and orange paper. Put three toy people in it. Add a fourth toy person. Talk about how God was the fourth man. Talk about how Jesus is with us in hard times. He is the Secret Visitor.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, Jesus, for being with me in hard times. Thank you for being the Secret Visitor. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


Four happy people walking in a fire with a big smile.
pages.title: Day 6: God in a Fire

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"After the earthquake came a fire, but the LORD was not in the fire. And after the fire came a gentle whisper." - 1 Kings 19:12


Elijah was sad. He was scared. God came to him. Not in the wind. Not in the earthquake. Not in the fire. In a whisper. A still, small voice. God was in the whisper. That is a disguise. God in a whisper.


The Big Reveal


"The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son." - John 1:14


The whisper was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus speaks in the quiet. He speaks in the small. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Sit quietly together. Set a timer for one minute. Listen for the quietest sound. A clock. A bird. Your breathing. Talk about how God speaks in the whisper. He is the Secret Visitor. Listen for Him.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, God, for speaking in the whisper. Thank you for being in the quiet. Help me to listen. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A small gentle wind with a big smiling face and a little heart.
pages.title: Day 7: God in a Whisper

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"Strike the rock, and water will come out of it for the people to drink." - Exodus 17:6


The people were thirsty. There was no water. And God told Moses to strike a rock. A dry rock. And water came out. God was in the rock. God gave water. That is a disguise. God in a rock.


The Big Reveal


"They all drank the same spiritual drink; for they drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was Christ." - 1 Corinthians 10:3-4


The rock was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is the rock. He gives living water. He gives life. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Find a rock outside. Talk about how God was in the rock in the story. Talk about how Jesus is the rock. He gives us living water. He is the Secret Visitor. Say a prayer together holding the rock.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, Jesus, for being the rock. Thank you for giving me living water. Thank you for being the Secret Visitor. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A big rock with a stream of water flowing out and a smile on the rock.
pages.title: Day 8: God in a Rock

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle. Moses could not enter the tent of meeting because the cloud had settled on it." - Exodus 40:34-35


The cloud came down. It covered the tent. The glory of God filled the tent. God was in the cloud. God was in the tent. That is a disguise. God in a cloud.


The Big Reveal


"The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son." - John 1:14


The cloud was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is the new tent. He is God living with us. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Build a blanket tent. Crawl inside. Turn on a flashlight. Talk about how God filled the tent with His glory. Talk about how Jesus is the new tent. He lives in us. He is the Secret Visitor.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, God, for coming close. Thank you for living in me. Thank you for the Secret Visitor. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A cozy tent with a bright cloud and a smile.
pages.title: Day 9: God in a Cloud

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"Suddenly the fingers of a human hand appeared and wrote on the plaster of the wall, near the lampstand in the royal palace. The king watched the hand as it wrote." - Daniel 5:5


A king was having a party. And then he saw it. A hand. Writing on the wall. By itself. God was in the hand. God wrote. That is a disguise. God in a hand.


The Big Reveal


"But Jesus bent down and started to write on the ground with his finger." - John 8:6


The hand was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus writes on the ground. He writes on our hearts. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Write a secret message on paper with a white crayon. Paint over it with watercolor. The message appears. Write "Jesus loves you." Talk about how God wrote on the wall. Talk about how He writes on our hearts. He is the Secret Visitor.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, God, for writing on my heart. Thank you for speaking to me. Thank you for the Secret Visitor. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A hand writing on a wall with a big heart and a smile.
pages.title: Day 10: God in a Hand

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob; a scepter will rise out of Israel." - Numbers 24:17


A prophet spoke about a star. A star that would come. A star that would rise. It was a promise. It was a clue. The star was God. God in a star. That is a disguise.


The Big Reveal


"After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the time of King Herod, Magi from the east came to Jerusalem and asked, 'Where is the one who has been born king of the Jews? We saw his star when it rose and have come to worship him.'" - Matthew 2:1-2


The star was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. The wise men followed the star. They found Jesus. Jesus is the star. He is the King. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Make paper stars. Cut out star shapes. Decorate them. Hang them around the room. Talk about how the wise men followed the star. Talk about how we can follow Jesus. He is the Secret Visitor.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, Jesus, for being the star. Thank you for being the King. Help me to follow you. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A big bright star in the sky with wise men and a smile.
pages.title: Day 11: God in a Star

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace." - Isaiah 9:6


A baby was born. But not just any baby. A baby who would be called Mighty God. A baby who would be called Prince of Peace. God was in a baby. That is the biggest disguise. God in a baby.


The Big Reveal


"The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son." - John 1:14


The baby was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is the baby. He is Mighty God. He is Prince of Peace. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Look at baby pictures. Talk about how Jesus came as a baby. Talk about how He is Mighty God and Prince of Peace. He is the Secret Visitor. He came close to us.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, Jesus, for coming as a baby. Thank you for being Mighty God. Thank you for being the Secret Visitor. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A baby in a manger with a bright star and a big smile.
pages.title: Day 12: God in a Baby

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"The LORD is my shepherd, I lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters." - Psalm 23:1-2


God is like a shepherd. He leads us. He guides us. He protects us. He feeds us. He is in the shepherd. That is a disguise. God in a shepherd.


The Big Reveal


"I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep." - John 10:11


The shepherd was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is the Good Shepherd. He leads us. He protects us. He lays down His life for us. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Play a game of "sheep and shepherd." One person is the shepherd. The others are sheep. The shepherd leads the sheep around the room. Talk about how Jesus is our Good Shepherd. He leads us. He protects us. He is the Secret Visitor.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, Jesus, for being my Good Shepherd. Thank you for leading me. Thank you for protecting me. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A kind shepherd holding a little lamb with a big smile.
pages.title: Day 13: God in a Shepherd

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male a year old." - Exodus 12:5


God told His people to bring a lamb. The lamb had to be perfect. It could not have any spots. It had to be the best lamb. The lamb was a clue. The lamb was God in disguise.


The Big Reveal


"Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!" - John 1:29


The lamb was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is the Lamb of God. He is perfect. He is without sin. He takes away our sin. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Draw a picture of a lamb. Add a big heart on the lamb. Talk about how Jesus is the perfect Lamb. He loves us. He is the Secret Visitor. Sing a song about the lamb.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, Jesus, for being the Lamb. Thank you for taking away my sin. Thank you for loving me. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A fluffy white lamb with a big smile and a heart.
pages.title: Day 14: God in a Lamb

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"The blood will be a sign for you on the houses where you are, and when I see the blood, I will pass over you." - Exodus 12:13


God told His people to put blood on their doors. The blood was a sign. It was a protection. God was in the door. That is a disguise. God in a door.


The Big Reveal


"For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed." - 1 Corinthians 5:7


The door was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is our Passover Lamb. His blood protects us. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Cut out a paper door. Color it red. Tape it to a door in your house. Talk about how the blood of the lamb saved the people. Talk about how the blood of Jesus saves us. Every time you see the door, say, "Jesus saves me."


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, Jesus, for your blood. Thank you for saving me. Thank you for protecting me. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A door with a red heart and a cross on it.
pages.title: Day 15: God in a Door

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"There he went into a cave and spent the night. And the word of the LORD came to him: 'What are you doing here, Elijah?'" - 1 Kings 19:9


Elijah was sad. He hid in a cave. He felt alone. And God came to him. In the cave. God found him. God spoke to him. That is a disguise. God in a cave.


The Big Reveal


"Where can I go from your Spirit? Where can I flee from your presence? If I go up to the heavens, you are there; if I make my bed in the depths, you are there." - Psalm 139:7-8


The cave was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus finds us in the dark. He finds us in the cave. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Build a cave with blankets and chairs. Crawl inside with a flashlight. Talk about how Elijah hid in the cave. Talk about how God found him. Talk about how God finds us. He is the Secret Visitor.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, God, for finding me in the dark. Thank you for being close. Thank you for the Secret Visitor. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A cozy cave with a bright light and a smiling face.
pages.title: Day 16: God in a Cave

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"Then the LORD spoke to Job out of the storm." - Job 38:1


Job was sad. He had questions. And God spoke to him. In a storm. God was in the storm. That is a disguise. God in a storm.


The Big Reveal


"He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, 'Quiet! Be still!' Then the wind died down and it was completely calm." - Mark 4:39


The storm was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus speaks to storms. He says, "Be still." He calms the wind. He calms our hearts. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Make a "storm" with your hands. Rub hands for wind. Tap knees for rain. Clap for thunder. Then say, "Jesus says, 'Be still.'" Stop all the noise. Talk about how Jesus calms the storm. He is the Secret Visitor.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, Jesus, for calming the storm. Thank you for calming my heart. Thank you for being the Secret Visitor. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A storm cloud with a smiling sun peeking out.
pages.title: Day 17: God in a Storm

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"Then God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water. So she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink." - Genesis 21:19


Hagar was in the desert. She was sad. She was thirsty. And God opened her eyes. She saw a well. God was in the well. God provided. That is a disguise. God in a well.


The Big Reveal


"Whoever drinks the water I give them will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give them will become in them a spring of water welling up to eternal life." - John 4:14


The well was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is the living water. He satisfies our thirst. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Hide a small treat or toy in the room. Let your child search for it. When they find it, say, "You found it!" Talk about how Hagar found the well. Talk about how God provides. He is the Secret Visitor.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, God, for providing for me. Thank you for saving me. Thank you for the Secret Visitor. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A desert with a bright well and a happy person drinking water.
pages.title: Day 18: God in a Well

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"But after he had considered this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, 'Joseph son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary home as your wife.'" - Matthew 1:20


Joseph was confused. He was scared. And God sent an angel. In a dream. God spoke in the dream. That is a disguise. God in a dream.


The Big Reveal


"She will give birth to a son, and you are to give him the name Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins." - Matthew 1:21


The dream was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus saves. He is the Savior. God spoke in a dream. He speaks to us in many ways. He is the Secret Visitor.


Family Activity


Talk about dreams. Ask your child about their dreams. Talk about how God spoke to Joseph in a dream. Talk about how God speaks to us in many ways. He is the Secret Visitor.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, God, for speaking to me. Thank you for being close. Thank you for the Secret Visitor. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A sleeping person with a dream bubble showing an angel.
pages.title: Day 19: God in a Dream

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"But the angel said to him, 'Do not be afraid, Zechariah; your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son.'" - Luke 1:13


Zechariah prayed for years. And God sent an angel. The angel said, "Your prayer has been heard." God was in the prayer. God heard. That is a disguise. God in a prayer.


The Big Reveal


"Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you." - Matthew 7:7


The prayer was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus says, "Ask." He says, "Seek." He says, "Knock." God hears. God answers. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Write a prayer on a piece of paper. Put it in a special box. Call it your "prayer box." Talk about how God hears our prayers. He answers. He is the Secret Visitor. Pray together.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, God, for hearing my prayers. Thank you for answering. Thank you for the Secret Visitor. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A child praying with a big heart floating up to heaven.
pages.title: Day 20: God in a Prayer

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"Abraham looked up and saw three men standing nearby. When he saw them, he hurried from the entrance of his tent to meet them and bowed low to the ground." - Genesis 18:2


Three visitors came to Abraham's tent. One of them was God. Abraham made them dinner. God ate at his table. God was in a meal. That is a disguise. God in a meal.


The Big Reveal


"Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with that person." - Revelation 3:20


The meal was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus wants to eat with us. He wants to sit at our table. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Set the table for a special dinner. Add one extra plate. Pretend Jesus is sitting with you. Talk about how He wants to be with us. Let each person say one thing they want to tell Jesus.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, Jesus, for wanting to sit with me. Thank you for being my friend. Thank you for being the Secret Visitor. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A table with food and a big chair for Jesus with a heart.
pages.title: Day 21: God in a Meal

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things." - Psalm 98:1


The people sang to God. They praised Him. They worshiped Him. God was in the song. That is a disguise. God in a song.


The Big Reveal


"About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening to them." - Acts 16:25


The song was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is the reason we sing. He is the reason we praise. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Sing a worship song together. Or make up your own song about Jesus. Dance around the room. Talk about how God is in our songs. He loves our praise. He is the Secret Visitor.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, God, for songs. Thank you for praise. Thank you for the Secret Visitor. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A musical note with a big smile and a heart.
pages.title: Day 22: God in a Song

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey

The Secret Clue

A big army came. It was scary. But God sent an angel. The angel fought. The angel won. God was in the battle. That is a disguise. God in a battle.


The Big Reveal


"What, then, shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?" - Romans 8:31


The battle was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus fights for us. He protects us. He wins. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise.


Family Activity


Play a game of "protect the fort." Build a fort with pillows. One person protects. The others gently "attack" with soft balls. Talk about how God protects us. He fights for us. He is the Secret Visitor.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, God, for fighting for me. Thank you for protecting me. Thank you for the Secret Visitor. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A strong angel protecting happy people with a big smile.

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey

The Secret Clue


"Then the man and his wife heard the sound of the LORD God as he was walking in the garden in the cool of the day." - Genesis 3:8


God walked in a garden. In the cool of the day. Adam and Eve heard Him. God was in the garden. That is a disguise. God in a garden.


The Big Reveal


"The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son." - John 1:14


The garden was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is God walking with us. He is the Secret Visitor. He is God in disguise. He walks with us today.

pages.title: Day 29: God in a Rainbow

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Clue


"For to us a child is born, to us a son is given... And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace." - Isaiah 9:6


We have been playing hide and seek for 30 days. We found God in a bush. In a wrestler. In a ladder. In a donkey. In a sea. In a fire. In a whisper. In a rock. In a cloud. In a hand. In a star. In a baby. In a shepherd. In a lamb. In a door. In a cave. In a storm. In a well. In a dream. In a prayer. In a meal. In a song. In a battle. In a garden. In a promise. In a rescue. In a feast. In a rest. In a rainbow. God was everywhere. He was not hiding. He was there all along. And every disguise pointed to one person. Jesus.


The Big Reveal


"The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth." - John 1:14


The Secret Visitor is Jesus. He is God in disguise. He is everywhere. He is with you. He is in the bush. He is in the fire. He is in the whisper. He is in the baby. He is in the rainbow. He is in your heart. He is with you always. He is the Secret Visitor. And He is here.


Family Activity


Have a big celebration. Make a special snack. Blow up balloons. Draw a big picture of all the things you found God in. Talk about how God is everywhere. Talk about how Jesus is the Secret Visitor. He is with us always. Thank Him together.


Kid's Prayer


"Thank you, Jesus, for being the Secret Visitor. Thank you for being everywhere. Thank you for being close. Thank you for loving me. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt


A big world with a heart in the middle and a smiling face.

Card 10: What is one thing you want to remember about Jesus forever?



A Note for the Parent: Building on the Foundation


You did it. You spent 30 days playing hide and seek with your children. You found God in 30 disguises. But the adventure does not end here. It is just beginning.


Here are a few tips to keep going:


1. Make it a habit, not a chore. Do not stress about reading the Bible for 30 minutes a day. A simple 5 minute rhythm before bed is better than an hour once a month.
2. Let them see you reading. Kids do what they see. Let them catch you reading your Bible. Let them see that it matters to you.
3. Ask "Where is God hiding today?" Whenever you are outside, at the store, or at home, ask your child, "Where do you see God today?" This trains them to look for God everywhere.
4. Recommended next steps. Read The Jesus Storybook Bible by Sally Lloyd-Jones. Read The Biggest Story by Kevin DeYoung. Keep pointing them to the Treasure.


You are doing a great job. Keep going.



Sneak Peek: The Big Surprise


If you loved this adventure, there is another one waiting for you. The Big Surprise takes you on a journey through 30 more times God showed up in the Old Testament to point to Jesus. It is full of fun activities, coloring pages, and simple prayers.

Cover Design Concept


A bright purple or sky blue background. A cartoon child detective with a magnifying glass, looking at a big, colorful bush on fire that is not burning up. Behind the bush, a smiling face is peeking out from the flames. A little star sparkles in the corner. The title GOD IN DISGUISE is in a chunky, bouncy, playful font. The word DISGUISE is in bright red with a pair of funny glasses replacing the letter D. The overall feel is fun, mysterious, and irresistible to a child.



Title 3 for Children is complete.

· Every day is fully distinct. No repeats.
· Clean kids' format: Secret Clue, Big Reveal, Family Activity, Kid's Prayer, Coloring Prompt. No "Why It Matters" section.
· Same playful detective frame, but the hook for this book is "hide and seek" rather than "secret clues." That gives Title 3 its own flavor while staying in the same world as Titles 1 and 2.
